standard.summary: Textual Inversion 不训练模型权重，而是学习一个新的文本嵌入向量。ti_placeholder_token 是占位符（如 '<new>'），模型学会将这个 token 与训练图片中的概念关联。
standard.effect: 训练后在推理时使用 <new> 即可触发学到的概念。ti_num_vectors 控制嵌入向量数量（多向量表达更丰富但推理时需要连续输入）。
standard.whenToUse: 想用文本方式触发特定风格/概念时。文件极小（只有几个向量）。不修改模型权重。
standard.avoidWhen: 需要精细控制生成细节时（TI 的控制力不如 LoRA）。多概念时可能冲突。

standard_en.summary: Textual Inversion does not train model weights; it learns a new text embedding vector instead. ti_placeholder_token is the placeholder ('<new>', say), and the model learns to associate that token with the concept in the training images.
standard_en.effect: After training, using <new> at inference triggers the learned concept. ti_num_vectors sets how many embedding vectors there are (more vectors express more, but then they have to be fed in consecutively at inference).
standard_en.whenToUse: When you want to trigger a particular style or concept through text. The file is tiny (just a few vectors). It does not modify the model weights.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you need fine control over generation detail (TI has less control than LoRA). Several concepts may conflict with each other.

advanced.principle: TI 只优化 text encoder 的 embedding 层——为 placeholder token 学习一个 d 维向量（SD1.5: 768d，SDXL: 1280d）。ti_init_token 指定初始化来源（如用 'dog' 的嵌入初始化学习狗的概念）。ti_num_vectors > 1 时学习多个连续向量，表达能力更强但推理时需要输入 '<new1> <new2> ...'。
advanced.intervention: text encoder 前向传播时替换 placeholder token 的 embedding 为可训练向量。
advanced.expectedImpact: 文件大小仅几 KB。推理时通过文本即可触发概念。
advanced.tradeoffs: ti_num_vectors 增加会提升表达力但增加 prompt 长度。

advanced_en.principle: TI optimizes only the text encoder's embedding layer — it learns a d-dimensional vector for the placeholder token (SD1.5: 768d, SDXL: 1280d). ti_init_token specifies the initialization source (e.g. initialize with 'dog''s embedding to learn a dog concept). With ti_num_vectors > 1 it learns multiple consecutive vectors — more expressive, but inference requires inputting '<new1> <new2> ...'.
advanced_en.intervention: During the text encoder forward, the placeholder token's embedding is replaced with the trainable vectors.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: File size is only a few KB. The concept is triggered at inference purely via text.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Raising ti_num_vectors increases expressiveness but lengthens the prompt.
